SELECT sku, SUM(units_sold) AS units, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue, MIN(date) AS d1, MAX(date) AS d2, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY sku;
SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits ORDER BY sku, audit_ts;
SELECT date, SUM(units_sold) AS total_units, COUNT(*) AS skus FROM store.daily_sales WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(qty) AS units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) AS bills_with_other_atta,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bills_with_5kg
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date IN (DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',DATE '2026-06-26')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT note, COUNT(*) FROM payments.pos_payments GROUP BY note ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20;
